messages:
riley: Quick follow-up from yesterday's authz postmortem. We saw permission-drift + a rotation job miss caused failures for metrics and billing. Need a tight remediation tracker with owners and dates.

nav: Root cause recap: namespace regex in rotation config was simplified during cleanup and accidentally excluded two pattern groups. Rotation ran but skipped those namespaces.

priya: I'll own the rotation hardening (RD-9001). Deliverables: preflight validation, idempotent rotations, canary run option, and rotation metrics. Target EOD 2026-04-06.

infra-bot: Created tickets on board: https://boards.redwood.ai/board/rd-authz-900  (RD-9001, RD-9002, RD-9003).

riley: RD-9002 -> alerts & recurring audit -> nav. Need a Splunk query + dashboard for tokens TTL>60d and secret path mismatches. Draft by 2026-03-30. Include pager rule for sustained rotation failures.

nav: WIP Splunk query: ```index=auth_logs sourcetype=token | where ttl_days>60 OR secret_path LIKE "/secret/%legacy%" | stats count by service, token_id``` Will refine into dashboard tiles.

priya: RD-9003 -> runbook + emergency rotation shortcut -> priya. Runbook should contain step-by-step manual rotate commands, verification smoke tests, and a one-click emergency canary. Draft: 2026-03-29.

security-eng: I'll run an inventory scan to list services referencing legacy secret paths and tokens with ttl>60d. Sending CSV before Tuesday; mark any hits as blockers.

priya: Manual rotations tonight for affected services: svc-metrics and svc-billing. Logs: ```rotate svc-metrics -> ok
rotate svc-billing -> ok
rotate svc-analytics -> failed: legacy path not remapped``` 

riley: svc-analytics is a blocker. Nav please include it in RD-9002 audit and mark infra ticket to remap path.

nav: Added svc-analytics to the board as blocker, opened infra ticket INF-2237 to remap secret path.

priya: I'll add a CI e2e that injects a bad namespace regex and asserts rotation_missed_namespaces==0 post-run; PR will block merges if check fails.

riley: Summary of owners and dates: RD-9001 (rotation) -> priya -> 2026-04-06; RD-9002 (audit/alerts) -> nav -> draft 2026-03-30; RD-9003 (runbook/manual) -> priya -> 2026-03-29. Short sync Fri 2026-04-02 09:00 PT (15m). Target closure 2026-04-15 if audits pass.

incident-bot: Linked postmortem: https://redwood.link/pm-authz-2026. Thanks all."
